question: The government initiative known as KIRTI, an acronym for Khelo India Rising Talent Identification, was inaugurated in ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **KIRTI** stands for **Khelo India Rising Talent Identification**. It is an initiative launched by the Government of India to identify and nurture young sports talent across the country.
 
• The primary goal of **KIRTI** is to promote sports culture and provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent at the national and international level.
 
• The initiative was officially launched in the year **2024**. *Hence, the correct answer is 2024.*
 
• **KIRTI** aims to bridge the gap in sports infrastructure and provide necessary resources like training, coaching, and facilities to aspiring athletes in India.
 
• This initiative is a part of the broader **Khelo India Programme**, which was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to encourage sports participation and the overall development of sports in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Programme:**

 
 
• Launched in **2018**, this programme is a flagship scheme of the Government of India to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroot level.
 
• Under this programme, talented players are identified in various sports disciplines and provided with financial assistance of **₹5 lakh annually** for a period of 8 years.
 
• The programme has successfully organized events like the **Khelo India Youth Games** and **Khelo India University Games**, which have become a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of KIRTI:**
 
 
• To identify young sports talent from schools, colleges, and various sports competitions across India and provide them with the required resources.
 
• To develop a strong network of sports infrastructure in both urban and rural areas to ensure accessibility for everyone.
 
• To create an ecosystem that encourages sports as a career option and elevates India’s performance on international platforms such as the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of KIRTI:**
 
 
• Focuses on grassroots-level talent identification and development.
 
• Encourages collaboration between the government, private sector, and sports federations for better results.
 
• Offers access to world-class coaching facilities and training under expert coaches to enhance athletes' performance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of Sports in Nation Building:**

 
 
• Sports play a significant role in fostering a sense of unity, discipline, and national pride. Initiatives like **KIRTI** help in identifying young talent and empowering them to represent the country at the global level.
 
• Such programmes contribute to the physical and mental well-being of individuals and help address issues like obesity and lifestyle diseases through increased participation in physical activities.
 
 
 
• **Major Sports Achievements of India:**
 
 
• **Olympics:** India has seen a steady rise in its medal tally in recent Olympics, with notable performances in sports like weightlifting, wrestling, and badminton.
 
• **Cricket:** India has won the ICC Cricket World Cup twice (in **1983** and **2011**), along with several other cricketing milestones.
 
• **Paralympics:** Indian athletes have excelled in the Paralympics, with remarkable performances in events like javelin throw, high jump, and badminton.
